description: Finnmark Combination Hybrid (Infrared & Traditional) Outdoor Barrel Sauna—FD-7, Thermo-Aspen Searching for a sauna that delivers both tradition and innovation in one? The FD-7 Combination Barrel Sauna blends the benefits Finnmark’s UL-listed Spectrum Plus™ infrared sauna panels with a traditional Finnish rock sauna, creating a wellness experience like no other. Designed with strength and elegance in mind, this sauna features thick Thermo-Aspen staves for lasting durability, complemented by antimicrobial cedar benches that stay smooth and cool even under high heat. Its tempered glass panels add a sleek, open aesthetic, while Wi-Fi-enabled controls, customizable RGB lighting, and powerful Finnmark Spectrum Plus™ infrared heaters ensure both comfort and efficiency. This is sauna luxury elevated-crafted to look stunning, perform flawlessly, and create the ultimate escape in your home. Features: Spectrum Plus™ UL Listed short wave infrared heaters for deep penetrating heat, up to 25x more than standard carbon panel heaters.
